_how_to_edit: One question per {...}. 'question': the text. 'answers': exactly 4. 'correct': the position of the right answer (0 = first, 1 = second, 2 = third, 3 = fourth). Optional 'explanation' (shown after answering) and 'image' (an https:// link, or a file name inside the images/ folder). Answers are shuffled when shown. The bot re-reads this file automatically. After editing, run: python check_trivia.py
